InviteEntry.description:
One invitation. ``key`` is the shared-link secret; everything else describes what
the redeeming user gets in the project's Keycloak realm.

application-url.description: Where the user is sent after redeeming.
application-url.title: Application-Url

auth-methods.description: The sign-in methods this invite offers; empty means every method the realm supports.
auth-methods.title: Auth-Methods

client-roles.description: Per client, the client roles the redeeming user is given. Advanced; not offered in the portal.
client-roles.title: Client-Roles

contact-email.description: Address shown to a user who needs help redeeming.
contact-email.title: Contact-Email

groups.description: Realm groups the redeeming user joins. Advanced; not offered in the portal.
groups.title: Groups

key.description: The secret in the invitation link; whoever holds it can redeem the invite. Send an empty string to have a random one generated -- the write reports it back under 'generated', which is the only place you learn a key you did not choose. It is RETURNED by a read of this config, deliberately: the code is the invitation, so whoever cannot read it back cannot send it on.
key.title: Key

message.description: Text shown on the invitation page.

realm-roles.description: Realm roles the redeeming user is given.
realm-roles.title: Realm-Roles

restrict-domain.description: Only accept an email address in this domain, so the link cannot be passed on freely.
restrict-domain.title: Restrict-Domain

roles.description: Deprecated spelling of 'realm-roles', kept so existing files validate. Use realm-roles.
roles.title: Roles

success-button.description: Label of the button leading to the application.

success-title.description: Heading shown after a successful redemption.

InviteEntry.title: InviteEntry

active.description: The invitations that can currently be redeemed.
active.title: Active

default-language.description: Language the invitation page opens in when the visitor expresses no preference.
default-language.title: Default-Language

title: InviteConfig
